```
env STARSHIP_LOG=trace starship module git_status
```

Something to note: MSYS2's `git` package is Cygwin `git`. Though I'm not sure how robust Starship support is for Cygwin `git` compared to Win32 `git` (`git-for-windows`).
I can mention that git_status is working correctly under msys2 with git provided by `scoop install git-with-openssh` (or install manually from https://gitforwindows.org )
it works fine on my msys2 installation
Closing this issue since we have multiple reports that this is working as expected.
